conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Well, it’s been a bit of a stretch lately, if I’m honest. I’ve been feeling more tired through the day and… there’s something about my sleep, but I’m not sure how much detail you want me to go into just yet. It’s kind of been building up over months, and I keep thinking it’ll settle, but it hasn’t really. Could you ask that another way?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What changes in your mood, sleep, energy, thoughts, or daily functioning have been troubling you most recently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Mostly the sleep, really. I’m having trouble falling asleep — it’s been about seven months since my shift pattern changed — and then I’m tired in the daytime. My mood is otherwise stable, though.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What would you like to achieve through assessment or treatment?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been assessed by a mental-health professional before, and if so, what was the assessment and when did it occur?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes… I was seen back in 2009 by a hospital psychiatry team, after an overdose during my divorce.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What diagnoses, if any, were you given during that 2009 assessment or at any other time?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: They said it was major depressive disorder, single episode, in full remission.

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever intentionally harmed yourself or attempted suicide, including the 2009 overdose, and if so, what happened and when?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes, that was the 2009 overdose during my divorce. But there’s been nothing like that since — no self-harm or suicidal thoughts for fifteen years.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Thank you for telling me. Have you had any previous psychotherapy or counseling, and if so, what type, when, and for how long?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yeah, I did have CBT. That was in 2010, at a community clinic, and it was about 12 sessions… I think that’s all I remember clearly.

conversation.message: I’m trying to think… I had one antidepressant before, citalopram, but I can’t remember if there was anything else like a program or group thing. For the citalopram, it was 20 mg daily and I was on it for about 18 months from 2009, then I stopped after I’d recovered well.
